runtime.name: Supermium
runtime.releaseNotes: Incorporates upstream fixes and security patches. Fixes #1922 and #1926: the browser appears as an option for a default browser when the installer is permitted to write to the registry.
runtime.distributionNotes: Copy the complete Supermium archive directory, preserving the version subdirectory and bundled DLLs. Do not run the archive-root setup.exe. Reproduce the Chromium copyright, license conditions, and disclaimer in distribution materials; preserve bundled third-party credits.

verification.method: Release-note SHA2-256 values matched the GitHub API asset digest fields. Both ZIP central directories were inspected using bounded HTTP byte ranges; executable paths and archive contents were verified without downloading full archives.

compatibilityReferences.notes: Supermium explicitly supports Windows 7 and supplies x86 and x64 builds. The existing Bulka web release uses dart2js and CanvasKit, so WasmGC is not required for its Dart application code. CanvasKit still uses WebAssembly; its engine has CPU rendering fallback when WebGL initialization fails. Chromium 144 also exceeds Flutter's documented WasmGC baseline of Chromium 119 if a future Bulka release enables Dart Wasm compilation. WebGL, software-rendering fallback, codecs, touch input, and all application workflows still require execution testing on representative Windows 7 devices; this lock is not certification by the Flutter team. Supermium does not automatically update, so runtime updates must be delivered by a reviewed Bulka installer release.
